description: Implement Commerce Graph entity types, repository ports, in-memory implementations, deterministic transforms, source priority, tombstones, freshness enforcement, mapping version publication/rollback, and comprehensive tests
steps: Step 1 - Refactor and extend types in packages/commerce-graph/src/index.ts: (a) Change PriceSnapshot.amount from string to use Money type (integer minor units as bigint per requirement 6.2). (b) Add tombstone/status fields to Product: 'status' field with values 'active'|'released'|'tombstoned'|'unpublished', 'tombstonedAt' as optional Instant. (c) Add 'sourceReferences' (plural, readonly array) to Product to support multiple sources with priority. (d) Add SourcePriority type: { readonly source: string; readonly priority: number }. (e) Add MappingTransform type: { readonly id: string; readonly name: string; readonly version: string; readonly schemaHash: Sha256Digest; readonly inputSchema: string; readonly outputSchema: string; readonly createdAt: Instant }. (f) Add MappingVersionRecord type with publish/rollback lifecycle: { readonly id: string; readonly merchantId: string; readonly version: string; readonly schemaHash: Sha256Digest; readonly transforms: readonly MappingTransform[]; readonly status: 'draft'|'published'|'rolledBack'; readonly publishedAt: Instant|null; readonly rolledBackAt: Instant|null; readonly createdAt: Instant }. (g) Add ConflictRecord type: { readonly id: string; readonly entityId: string; readonly entityType: string; readonly sources: readonly SourceReference[]; readonly conflictType: 'value_mismatch'|'stale_override'|'concurrent_update'; readonly resolvedAt: Instant|null; readonly resolution: 'source_priority'|'newer_wins'|'manual'|null; readonly createdAt: Instant }. (h) Add RawNormalizedPreview type: { readonly rawData: unknown; readonly normalizedData: unknown; readonly transformId: string; readonly transformVersion: string; readonly differences: readonly string[] }. Update existing index.test.ts structural tests to match new type shapes.

Step 2 - Create packages/commerce-graph/src/repositories.ts: Define repository port interfaces: ProductRepository (save, getById, getByExternalId, listByMerchant, listByStatus, softDelete/tombstone), VariantRepository (save, getById, getByProductId, getBySkuAndMerchant), PriceRepository (save, getLatest, getHistory, getByVariantAndSource), InventoryRepository (save, getLatest, getHistory, getByVariantAndSource), MappingVersionRepository (save, getById, getPublished, publish, rollback, listByMerchant), ConflictRepository (save, getById, getUnresolved, resolve). All methods return Result<T> or Result<T|null>.

Step 3 - Create packages/commerce-graph/src/in-memory-repositories.ts: In-memory Map-based implementations of all repository ports. Use proper observation ordering: newer observedAt wins for same source (out-of-order handling). Products with 'tombstoned' status are retained but excluded from active queries. Include proper immutability with Object.freeze on returned entities.

Step 4 - Create packages/commerce-graph/src/transforms.ts: Implement deterministic transform engine. (a) TransformRegistry: register/get transforms by id+version. (b) applyTransform(rawData, transformId, version): applies a registered transform deterministically (same input always same output). (c) previewTransform(rawData, transformId, version): returns RawNormalizedPreview without committing. (d) Transforms must be pure functions (no side effects, no randomness). (e) Include a built-in 'shopify-product' transform example that maps raw Shopify-like product JSON to the normalized Product type.

Step 5 - Create packages/commerce-graph/src/source-priority.ts: Implement source priority resolution. (a) resolveConflict(observations from multiple sources, priorities): returns the winning observation based on configured priority. (b) When same priority, newer observedAt wins. (c) When conflict cannot be resolved, create a ConflictRecord. (d) detectStaleOverride(existingObservation, newObservation): determines if a new observation is actually older (out-of-order) and should be rejected.

Step 6 - Create packages/commerce-graph/src/freshness.ts: Implement freshness enforcement for commerce graph entities. (a) assessEntityFreshness(entity with observedAt, policy): leverages FreshnessPolicy to determine if entity data is fresh/approaching_stale/stale/unknown. (b) enforceFreshnessPolicy(entity, policy, mode: 'block'|'degrade'): returns Result indicating whether the entity can be used. (c) Re-uses evaluateFreshness from @counter/connector-sdk where possible.

Step 7 - Create packages/commerce-graph/src/commerce-graph.test.ts: Comprehensive test suite covering: (a) Provenance completeness - every saved entity must have source, time, mapping version. (b) Integer money - prices stored as bigint minor units, no floating point. (c) Variant identity - variants are uniquely identified by id and sku within a merchant. (d) Stale data detection - entities past freshness budget are flagged. (e) Out-of-order observation handling - later timestamp wins even if received first. (f) Tombstone behavior - tombstoned products excluded from active queries but retained. (g) Source priority resolution - higher priority source wins. (h) Mapping version publish/rollback lifecycle. (i) Transform determinism - same input always same output. (j) Preview mode - raw vs normalized without committing. (k) Conflict detection and resolution.

Step 8 - Update packages/commerce-graph/src/index.ts to export all new modules: repositories, in-memory-repositories, transforms, source-priority, freshness. Ensure all exports use proper ESM syntax with verbatimModuleSyntax (use 'export type' for type-only exports).
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter @counter/commerce-graph typecheck passes with zero errors
pnpm --filter @counter/commerce-graph test passes with all tests green
PriceSnapshot uses integer minor units (bigint) not string/float for amounts
Every product/variant/price/inventory entity retains source reference, observed time, and mapping version
Out-of-order observations are correctly handled (later timestamp wins regardless of arrival order)
Tombstoned products are excluded from active queries but retained in storage
Source priority correctly resolves conflicts between multiple sources
MappingVersion supports publish and rollback lifecycle transitions
Transforms are deterministic (same input always produces same output)
Preview mode shows raw vs normalized comparison without mutating state
Freshness assessment correctly identifies stale entities per policy
At least 15 meaningful tests covering all required test categories
findings: Review iteration 1 complete. Fixed all 7 issues: (1) Shopify transform now accepts optional TransformContext for merchantId/fetchedAt, (2) resolveConflict uses deterministic ID suffix instead of Date.now(), (3) InMemoryInventoryRepository now has out-of-order protection, (4) dead code branch removed from InMemoryPriceRepository.save, (5) computeDifferences now detects value changes via deepEqual, (6) publish() revokes previous published version for same merchant, (7) ConflictRepository.resolve uses ResolutionStrategy type.
